products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and image editing application. The foundation describes its project as community-governed and freely available, with no cloud dependency required for its core functionality.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what the site tracks as Krita AI, which incorporates local AI plugins into the open-source Krita application. Because the AI features run locally rather than through cloud services, users are not required to connect to external infrastructure to make use of them. The project operates under community governance consistent with its open-source foundation structure.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with the Krita Foundation in the held data.
